messages:
marta_marketing: Heads-up: planning to publish a benchmark deep-dive Tue 9:00 AM PT. Need embargo, CEO quote, and analyst outreach.
oliver_pr: Copy. Embargo until 9:00 AM PT. One-line pitch for press?
marta_marketing: Pitch: 'Redwood Inference benchmark shows meaningful cost reductions while preserving p99 latency across common inference workloads.'
ana_eng: Uploaded figures + raw CSVs to /shared/benchmarks/jun-2025. Method blurb for press: 'Tests run on representative workloads across two model families and three infra configs; metrics: p99, throughput, cost/token.'
oliver_pr: Draft CEO quote: "We're helping teams run production models reliably and cost-effectively." @kevin_ceo please review.
kevin_ceo: Approve with small change: use 'with predictable economics' instead of 'cost-effectively'. Quote approved.
nina_support: Support will monitor channels for 3 hours post-publish. Share internal FAQ and triage channel when ready.
marta_marketing: FAQ: https://drive.redwood/support/faq/benchmark-jun-2025.pdf. Staging has frontmatter `bench_publish=true` and `noindex: true`.
deploy-bot: publish job scheduled: job_id=bench-jun25, scheduled_time=1759003200, embargo=true. :white_check_mark:
oliver_pr: I'll send embargo email to press list at 4:30 PM PT and offer interviews. Please do not comment publicly until live.
marta_marketing: Final check complete: assets in drive, CEO quote approved, embargo set. I'll post 'ready' at 4:15 PM PT. :rocket:
